rationale: The plan identifies the design correctly and applies exactly the right test: DESeq2 LRT of ~condition+time+condition:time against ~condition+time, with time as an ordered factor, explicit reference levels, per-timepoint simple effects as descriptive follow-up, and an honest n=3 power caveat; it also flags the 25-vs-24 sample mismatch as something to resolve before modeling. QC is thorough and design-aware (blind VST used only for QC, PCA on top 500 genes colored by condition and time, distance heatmap, library sizes, no silent sample dropping), the filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, tied to smallest group size) is minimal and justified, and multiple testing (BH, alpha=0.05 passed to results, p-value histogram check, Cook's NA accounting) plus apeglm/ashr shrinkage restricted to reporting are handled correctly. Normalization is implicitly DESeq2 median-of-ratios and raw counts are correctly fed to the model, but size-factor estimation is never named explicitly, so it loses a point. Enrichment names collections with versions, an explicit universe of tested genes, and a 15-500 size window, but ranking a preranked GSEA on the non-negative LRT statistic yields an unsigned ranking that fgsea handles poorly; a signed metric (e.g., per-timepoint shrunken LFC or a directional summary) would have been the sound choice. Reporting requirements are complete and specific.
